decisions_requested.statement: Approve the six-mode drill cycle for OPI 5 and 6 in slots 025-036, reusing the established Activation pattern without declaring it universal grammar.
Approve slots 025-030 as drills of EN VALI KUVAN KE with bare [PLACE] response, preserving VALI historical provenance and KUVAN=CANDIDATE.
Approve slots 031-036 as drills of EN KU VALA KE in explicit work/school context, preserving VALA=CANDIDATE and avoiding a generic HNK DO verb.
Approve TRACE_GIDS for these drills as structural G-ID training only, with Candidate D visuals remaining PREPRODUCTION_NOT_OFFICIAL.
Confirm P03 is new SimpleWay HNK v1.1 authorship derived from validated OPI and not reconstruction of the missing historical Activation payload.

explicit_non_effects: Does not create new HNK lexical forms.
Does not promote KUVAN or VALA.
Does not alter VALI recovered provenance.
Does not create a generic DO verb.
Does not make Candidate D drawings official visual canon.
Does not promote any Activation slot to FROZEN.
application_rule: Do not transition Activation P03 to VALIDATED until all five scoped decisions are explicitly approved.
